params.body:
Step 1 of removing the "demo gebruiker" flag: an artisan command that retires every garage flagged `dealers.is_demo_user = 1`. Demos are given on live accounts now, so these garages have no use left. The flag itself and the filters that read it are step 2 and are not touched here.

## What is affected on production (read 1 October 2026)

Eight garages, none with a sign-in or a page view in the 30 days before:

- #68 Demo 4, #69 LKQ Belgium demo FR, #70 Demo 3, #71 Demo 1, #72 LKQ Belgium demo NL, #74 Demo Ilse, #75 Demo 2: March 2022, module 1 and 2, one user each, 5 to 6 cars for sale, 4 to 5 of them on the stocklist.
- #382 Mollie BV: March 2025, module 1 only, one user, no cars.

About 39 demo cars, about 31 on the shared stock. Today they are hidden from the other garages only by the demo filter (`StocklistBrowser`, `VehicleRepository::extendedSearch`, ...), which is exactly what step 2 removes. So the cars have to go first.

## `stocklist:retire-demo-accounts`

```
php artisan stocklist:retire-demo-accounts              # dry run, writes nothing
php artisan stocklist:retire-demo-accounts --apply      # retire them
php artisan stocklist:retire-demo-accounts --dealer=68  # narrow to some garages (repeatable)
```

The dry run prints, per garage: modules and transport, users (with last sign-in), cars (for sale, on the stocklist, on Nederland Mobiel, on a portal), the webhook receivers that will hear the removals, and what `--apply` will do. It also says up front whether webhooks and Nederland Mobiel leave from this environment or are sealed.

`--apply`, per garage, in this order:

1. Every car is deleted through `IVehicleRepository::delete`, the call a dealer's own delete makes (`OwnStockController::destroy`). So `VehicleObserver::deleted` runs as usual: soft delete, photos/damage/options, `VehiclePublisher::removed` (a `delete` to the receivers, the advert off Nederland Mobiel). The observer only does that with a garage in view (`Auth::user()->dealer`), so the command acts as one of the garage's users while it deletes (or an unsaved user of that garage when it has none). The Outbound seal decides as always.
2. Module 1, module 2 and transport off, as a customer who stopped.
3. and 4. Users and garage deleted with the same repository calls as "delete garage" (`DealerController::destroy`: `IDealerRepository::delete`, `IUserRepository::deleteWhere`). Dealers and users are not soft-deleted in this app, so neither is here. Cars stay soft-deleted.

A garage without the flag is never touched, also when named with `--dealer`. A second run prints "No demo garages left."; a run that failed halfway picks the same garage up again.

## Found on the way: "delete garage" fails for a garage with its own option order

`dealer_has_options` has a foreign key on `dealers.id` without cascade. `IDealerRepository::delete` on a garage that ever saved its own option order fails with error 1451 (confirmed locally), so the admin button gives a 500 and deletes nothing. The command detaches the order first (`$dealer->options()->detach()`, as "reset order" does). The admin button is not changed here; written down as `bevinding: garage-verwijderen-faalt-met-eigen-optievolgorde` (open).

## Mollie BV exclusion removed

`DealerHasOpenWorklistItemsCommand` excluded `dealer_id != 382` (Mollie BV) from the release-notes part of the worklist mail. That garage is one of the eight; once retired it no longer exists, so the literal is gone. Until `--apply` has run on production, Mollie BV's single user could get a release-notes mail at 07:45, so run the apply right after this deploys. R P1-2.11 no longer names the exception.

## Business rules

- New: **R P2-1.12** (the retirement, with the order of the steps and the production count).
- Changed: **R P1-2.11** (dealer 382 exception removed, with the date).
- New finding: `2026-10-01-garage-verwijderen-faalt-met-eigen-optievolgorde`.

Rules that change in step 2 (flag removal), from the `is_demo_user` filters: R S2-1.4 (shared stock excludes demo dealers), R P2-1.6 and R P2-1.10 (the demo switch in the garage list), R P2-1.11 (demo flag not on the sheet), R P2-3.1 (login filters on the demo flag per database), R P2-10.10 and R P2-10.27 (insights exclude demo dealers), R S3-2.1, R S3-2.13, R S3-4.3 and R S2-8.5 (Car-Pass demo behaviour for demo users). Rules that say "demo" about the demo environment (`Demo::active()`, the seal: R P1-7.1, R P3-4.1, R S3-1.6, P3-7) are a different thing and stay.

## Tests

`RetireDemoAccountsCommandTest` (no real HTTP: `Http::preventStrayRequests`, `Queue::fake`, `OwnStockService` spied):

- the dry run describes the garage and writes nothing;
- apply soft-deletes the cars, deletes the user and the garage, queues exactly one `delete` to the garage's receiver for the complete car (the incomplete one never rings, R S2-10.5), withdraws the Nederland Mobiel advert once, and leaves a non-demo garage, its user and its car untouched;
- a second run is a no-op;
- with the seal closed nothing is queued, Nederland Mobiel is not called and no HTTP leaves, while the garage still goes;
- a garage with its own option order is deleted;
- a named non-demo garage is left alone.

Mutation-checked: without acting as the garage the apply test fails (no delete reaches the receivers); without detaching the options the option-order test fails on the foreign key.

Full suite, PHPStan and pint (new files) run locally.

## Production

```
php artisan stocklist:retire-demo-accounts
php artisan stocklist:retire-demo-accounts --apply
```
